name: Mythic Master Craftsman (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
Your skill with a craft is like magic.

Prerequisites: Master Craftsman, 5 ranks in any Craft or Profession skill.

Benefit(s): Select one spellcasting class. For purposes of using or creating magic items, you are considered to know all the spells on that classes’ spell list, up to a spell level equal to half your ranks in the Craft or Profession skill you selected with the Master Craftsman feat.
